source.title: South meadow river crossing
source.purpose: Proposed narrow footbridge on an existing watercourse: allows MM6–8 parties to reach Reger and the southern melon patches. No road across the meadow.
source.evidence: adaptation: current MM6–8 Swimming equivalence is unresolved; check exact bank geometry before native build

source.title: Reger islet foot crossing
source.purpose: Narrow raised crossing from the hermitage islet eastern landing to the southern meadow bank. Preserve the original islet; bank ramps still need authored geometry.

bridges.geometryStatus: Specified; meshes and native traversal remain outstanding.

method: Each proposed surface triangle is checked at its edges split by native grid/diagonal crossings and at contained native grid vertices. These cover extrema of the difference between piecewise-linear surfaces. Bank edges meet native ground; deck clearance is checked over full width.
limits: Walking surfaces only. Author and check structural undersides, pile feet, rails and abutments; then inspect actual renders and prove ordinary native movement in both directions.
